top_risk_increasing_factors.clinical_meaning: Vascular Age × Systolic Burden: Synergistic cardiovascular hazard where advanced arterial age amplifies the harm of hypertension.
Patient Weight: Gross body mass influencing total blood volume and cardiac cardiac output demands.
Task-Specific Engineered Lifestyle Score: Linear heuristic (+1.0 active, -0.5 smoke, -0.5 alco); exploratory interaction, not a validated biomarker.
Log Pulse Pressure: Skew-stabilized representation of large-artery pulsatile load.
Diastolic Blood Pressure: Resting systemic vascular resistance between contractions; high values indicate continuous microvascular tension.

top_risk_reducing_factors.clinical_meaning: Systolic Blood Pressure: Peak arterial pressure during ventricular contraction; primary mechanical driver of vascular remodeling and coronary wall stress.
Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP): Mean systemic perfusion pressure determining end-organ perfusion and systemic vascular strain.
Pulse Pressure (ap_hi - ap_lo): Primary hemodynamic marker of arterial wall stiffening and diminished aortic compliance.
ACC/AHA Stage 2 Hypertension: Clinically severe blood pressure elevation (>=140 SBP or >=90 DBP).
Body Mass Index: Anthropometric estimate of adiposity; correlates with left ventricular hypertrophy and systemic inflammation.
